successors.name: Sukhothai Kingdom
successors.text: the northern part, per 'Split up by Singasari in south and Sukhothai in north: 1278'; Nakhon Si Thammarat tributary of Sukhothai from 1283

successors.name: Singhasari
successors.text: the southern part, per the page

ledger.x: c. 2nd century: Tambralinga (Tamali) first appears. The page has it 'existing at least from the 2nd to 13th centuries CE' and 'first mentioned in the Mahaniddesa: c. 2nd century CE'; the year 150 is a placeholder for 'c. 2nd century'. Repair pass, same page: the earliest local evidence is 'Inscription No. 28, dated to…

wars.name: Tambralinga-Lavo-Haripuñjaya wars (925-927)
wars.outcome: Jivaka (Sujita) of Tambralinga takes Lavapura and places his son Kambojaraja on the throne; Lavo and Haripunjaya are the other belligerents.

wars.name: Chandrabhanu's invasions of Sri Lanka (1244-1247)
wars.outcome: Chandrabhanu invades Sri Lanka in 1244 or 1247 (the page gives both) and Tambralinga reaches its 'largest extent in 1244'; no territory on the mainland changes.

certainty.note: Epigraphic and chronicle sources; the page names towns, no frontier, and mixes Tambralinga with Siridhammana.
